story_text:
As an API consumer, I want API versioning so that my integration doesn't break when the API is updated.

AC1: URL-based versioning: /api/v1/, /api/v2/
AC2: Deprecated versions return Sunset header
AC3: Breaking changes require new major version
AC4: Backward-compatible changes allowed in minor versions
AC5: Version negotiation via Accept header
AC6: Deprecation notice 6 months before removal
architecture_text: FastAPI with versioned routers. Deprecation middleware adds Sunset/Deprecation headers. API gateway handles version routing. OpenAPI spec per version.
